mapper.select:
select id, user_id as userId, username, role, role_level as roleLevel, module, method_name as methodName, action_type as actionType, resource_id as resourceId, resource_type as resourceType, resource_name as resourceName, description, status, exception, request_uri as requestUri, request_method as requestMethod, ip, user_agent as userAgent, duration_ms as durationMs, result_code as resultCode, current_point as currentPoint, contribution, happen_time as happenTime from osh_user_action_event
order by happen_time desc, id desc

select count(1) as totalEvents, count(distinct user_id) as activeUsers, sum(case when status is null then 0 when result_code = '1000' then 0 when status in ('SUCCESS', '成功', '操作成功', '0') then 0 else 1 end) as failedEvents, sum(case when contribution = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as contributionEvents, ifnull(avg(duration_ms), 0) as avgDurationMs from osh_user_action_event

select
date_format(happen_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') date_format(happen_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
as label, count(1) as value, count(distinct user_id) as activeUsers from osh_user_action_event
group by label order by label asc

select module as label, count(1) as value from osh_user_action_event
group by module order by value desc limit 20

select action_type as label, count(1) as value from osh_user_action_event
group by action_type order by value desc limit 20

select user_id as userId, max(username) as username, max(role) as roleCode, max(role_level) as roleLevel, count(1) as eventCount, max(happen_time) as lastHappenTime from osh_user_action_event
group by user_id order by eventCount desc limit 30
mapper.sql: select 'course' as resource_type, id as resource_id, ifnull(buy_count, 0) + ifnull(sales_count, 0) as purchase_count, ifnull(view_count, 0) as view_count, ifnull(collection_count, 0) as collect_count, ifnull(like_count, 0) + ifnull(good_count, 0) as like_count, 0 as use_count from osh_course where ifnull(delete_flag, 0) = 0 union all select 'book' as resource_type, id as resource_id, 0 as purchase_count, 0 as view_count, ifnull(sub_count, 0) as collect_count, 0 as like_count, 0 as use_count from osh_book where ifnull(delete_flag, 0) = 0 union all select 'tool' as resource_type, id as resource_id, 0 as purchase_count, ifnull(view_count, 0) as view_count, ifnull(collection_count, 0) as collect_count, ifnull(good_count, 0) as like_count, ifnull(total_usage, 0) as use_count from osh_tool where ifnull(delete_flag, 0) = 0 union all select 'info_gap' as resource_type, id as resource_id, 0 as purchase_count, ifnull(view_count, 0) as view_count, ifnull(collect_count, 0) as collect_count, ifnull(good_count, 0) as like_count, 0 as use_count from osh_info_gap where ifnull(delete_flag, 0) = 0 union all select 'website' as resource_type, id as resource_id, 0 as purchase_count, ifnull(click_count, 0) as view_count, ifnull(collection_count, 0) as collect_count, ifnull(good_count, 0) as like_count, 0 as use_count from osh_practical_website where ifnull(delete_flag, 0) = 0 union all select 'open_project' as resource_type, id as resource_id, 0 as purchase_count, ifnull(click_count, 0) as view_count, 0 as collect_count, ifnull(star_count, 0) as like_count, 0 as use_count from osh_open_project where ifnull(delete_flag, 0) = 0

left join ( select contribution_id, ifnull(sum(revenue_amount), 0) as revenue_amount, ifnull(sum(point_amount), 0) as point_amount, count(id) as revenue_count from osh_resource_revenue_record where delete_flag = 0 group by contribution_id ) rv on rv.contribution_id = c.id

left join (
) m on m.resource_type = c.resource_type and m.resource_id = c.resource_id
mapper.select:
select c.contributor_user_id as contributorUserId, max(c.contributor_username) as contributorUsername, max(c.contributor_role_level) as contributorRoleLevel, count(distinct c.id) as resourceCount, ifnull(sum(rv.revenue_amount), 0) as revenueAmount, ifnull(sum(rv.point_amount), 0) as pointAmount, ifnull(sum(rv.revenue_count), 0) as revenueCount, ifnull(sum(ifnull(m.purchase_count, 0)), 0) as purchaseCount, ifnull(sum(ifnull(m.view_count, 0)), 0) as viewCount, ifnull(sum(ifnull(m.collect_count, 0)), 0) as collectCount, ifnull(sum(ifnull(m.like_count, 0)), 0) as likeCount, ifnull(sum(ifnull(m.use_count, 0)), 0) as useCount, round(ifnull(sum(), 0), 2) as contributionPoints from osh_resource_contribution c
group by c.contributor_user_id order by contributionPoints desc, revenueAmount desc, resourceCount desc

select c.id, c.contributor_user_id as contributorUserId, c.contributor_username as contributorUsername, c.contributor_role_level as contributorRoleLevel, c.resource_type as resourceType, c.resource_id as resourceId, c.resource_name as resourceName, c.status, c.create_time as createTime, ifnull(rv.revenue_amount, 0) as revenueAmount, ifnull(rv.point_amount, 0) as pointAmount, ifnull(rv.revenue_count, 0) as revenueCount, ifnull(m.purchase_count, 0) as purchaseCount, ifnull(m.view_count, 0) as viewCount, ifnull(m.collect_count, 0) as collectCount, ifnull(m.like_count, 0) as likeCount, ifnull(m.use_count, 0) as useCount, round(, 2) as contributionPoints from osh_resource_contribution c
order by contributionPoints desc, revenueAmount desc, c.create_time desc
